Training CPU is therefore counted as min(guard CPU, wall) (single-threaded child; validated: A s0 child process_time 734 s, wall 753 s, guard 2,025 s). Original guard records unchanged; all later launches are one OS process per job. Corrected training spend 33,683 / 35,000 CPU-s
